message.content: SMART CSS EXTRACTION + REBUILD for navbar and footer. Project: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/` ## YOUR METHOD — for each component: 1. Read the Webflow HTML (`boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html`) — find the section, note EVERY CSS class name used 2. Grep the Webflow CSS (`boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css`) for each class — extract the EXACT CSS rules including ALL responsive media queries (991px, 767px, 479px, 1280px, 1440px) 3. Create a CSS module file (`.module.css`) containing ONLY those extracted rules 4. Convert the HTML to JSX using `styles.className` from the CSS module 5. Replace `` with `next/image`, replace Webflow JS with React state/framer-motion ## FILES TO CREATE/MODIFY ### Navbar: - CREATE `src/components/layout/navbar.module.css` — extracted CSS for all nav classes - REWRITE `src/components/layout/navbar.tsx` — JSX using CSS module + original Webflow class structure - REWRITE `src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx` — Sheet-based mobile menu ### Footer: - CREATE `src/components/layout/footer.module.css` — extracted CSS for all footer classes - REWRITE `src/components/layout/footer.tsx` — JSX using CSS module + original Webflow class structure ## CRITICAL RULES - The CSS module must contain the EXACT Webflow CSS values — copy them verbatim from the CSS file - In CSS modules, class names with hyphens need camelCase in JS: `.nav-23-link` → `styles['nav-23-link']` or `styles.nav23Link` (use bracket notation to keep original names) - Include ALL media queries for each class (grep the entire CSS file, classes appear multiple times at different breakpoints) - Images: `/images/webflow/FILENAME` - `"use client"` only for interactive parts (hamburger toggle, newsletter form) - NO `any` types - Keep ALL text content word-for-word from the HTML - The navbar has a banner strip, logo, nav links, Solutions dropdown (rich card), Resources dropdown (simple card), Login button, Schedule Demo button, hamburger - The footer has newsletter card, logo, social icons, 4-column links grid, copyright pill ## HOW TO EXTRACT CSS For each class like `.nav-23-link`: ```bash grep -n "\.nav-23-link" boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css ``` This will show every occurrence including responsive versions. Copy ALL of them into the CSS module. START NOW. Read HTML first, then extract CSS, then write files.
